class_policy.person: Visible on-pitch people, including referees; one box per person; visible extent for occlusion and crop-edge truncation.
class_policy.ball: Only visibly identifiable in-play ball. Tight visible extent; no guessed box when occluded. Spare balls outside field are masked.

selection: 48 distinct source frames in eight temporal phases. 36 ball-positive and 12 visually inspected ball-absent crops. One crop per source frame; no augmented duplicates.
person_proposal_model: Ultralytics YOLO11n COCO, imgsz=1280, person confidence >=0.12; proposals corrected visually
ball_annotation: Native-pixel visual identification and correction; candidate detector outputs were not accepted without visual inspection.
